$clr_1Network intercept
$clr_2- Mitka Vagon: Heard the boys set up a sit-down at Agroprom?
- Arkasha Gringo: The whole Zone heard. Someone leaked it to the army - and it kicked off for real.
- Mitka Vagon: Damn. Probably fat to cut a deal with the army and finish off the survivors.
- Arkasha Gringo: Business plan of the year, except the army are not complete idiots and do not take bribes during ops like that. So if you lack heavy gear and ammo to spare - better stay out when the rumors start.
- Grishka Besyak: I pulled three general-grade boilers out of there last time. Why not - no mutants, just run fast and do not screw around.
